description: Ricardo's six Quality AO packets (SharePoint QCQA, /AOs/2026 - AOs) read through the GET-only Graph adapter (integrations/graph_read.py SharePointReader) by the generic folder-originals check (operating.sharepoint_originals; the folder, the file-name pattern AO-<5 digits><letter>.pdf and the expected identity all come from evals/dev/cases/ao_originals_expected.json): folder listed, every matching file downloaded under the byte cap and SHA-256 compared with that file. Output: counts, byte sizes and SHA-256 digests only (no page text, names of people or URLs). Needs MICROSOFT_GRAPH_TENANT_ID, MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID, MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET and SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID (pins the download host); optional PLX_QCQA_DRIVE_ID (the expected file's drive_env) overrides the expected drive id. Read-only: GET only, token POST only. Until a live-check result exists this adapter is live-unverified.
notes: A packet whose read fails stays one files row with error_class, http_status, error_code (a class from integrations.live_source_guard.ERROR_CODE_TOKENS) and the fixed detail token, never a message or body; a failure before the packets (token, folder listing) prints the same http_status and error_code on the stderr error line, which the runner publishes. Injected-transport tested (operating/tests/test_ao_originals.py, the generic check through operating.sharepoint_originals; it replaced the AO-named operating.ao_originals with the same reads and the same assertions, the matched-file count renamed ao_pdfs -> matching_files); live-unverified until the live check records a result.
